explanation:
[EFFECT] Month has a non-monotonic effect. Winter months (January and February) suppress demand noticeably, spring and summer months are closer to neutral, and the autumn months — particularly October — produce the highest positive contribution. October is the peak month, with September and November also positive, while July and August are surprisingly close to neutral or slightly negative.
[IMPORTANCE] Ranked fourth, month has a moderate effect, roughly one-third the size of temperature's influence, and plays a secondary seasonal-adjustment role on top of temperature.
[RECOMMENDATION] Plan your bike availability and staffing primarily around the hour of the day — ensuring high fleet availability and staff support around the 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. peaks — and secondarily around temperature, scaling up resources on warm days (around 20–31 °C) and scaling back on cold or very rainy days.
